descricao: The Waiting Line: The Waiting Line is, as said in its name, the area in which customers will wait their turn to order. Although few who enter the Waiting Line are also wanderers, Facelings with the Level 11 effect frequently make up the rest of the Waiting Line. There are a few occasions in which the number of entities within the Waiting Line is short - however, the amount of time it takes to advance to the front is very lengthy. At this moment, one will feel the need to cut, push, or complain to whoever is in front of them.
